voltage_noise_selection: selected using cell 59294, 25C WLTP and candidate values 0.005, 0.02, 0.05 V in the preceding experiment
mode_selection: minimum mean development EKF one-step prior voltage RMSE
soc_reference: same-cell and temperature C20 discharge voltage anchor at each drive start plus current integration; proxy, not an independent SOC measurement
temperature: nominal chamber setpoint, not surface temperature
calibration: same-cell C20 and pre-driving HPPC 1C, including for held-out cells; no unseen-cell zero-shot claim
eis: recorded after driving and audited only; not used to parameterize preceding driving
